description:
About the job

Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead
About Flowerburst

We are the fastest growing and most disruptive business in publishing since Amazon. 




Flowerburst starts movements — ideas that burst into life radiantly. Publishing is broken: more than 80 percent of Americans feel they have a book in them, and only about 1 percent ever publish it. After taking 2-3 years to go to market, nine out of ten traditionally published titles fail to turn a profit. Why? There are three middle men between the author and end customer, and there simply isn’t enough margin for any party to invest in marketing. 




Success on self-publishing platforms like Amazon KDP is even more elusive – they leave authors marketing blind and without cashflow: Amazon KDP doesn't show authors who their customers are and where they came from, and pay 60+ days after a sale is made. The result is centuries of gatekeeping in which the best ideas rarely reach the people who need them, dying on shelves in the back of bookstores, undiscovered. We are building the company that fixes this: an AI publishing platform fused with social, direct-to-consumer commerce. The AI platform allows anyone, anywhere to compile their idea in book form - helping the author exactly where they need it. Social commerce allows authors to place books in the heart of culture – social media feeds – to get discovered, even by audiences who typically don’t read books. Anyone, anywhere can write a book and get it to the masses. The end goal is a literary revolution.




The flywheel is already turning and validation has been immediate. In under 12 months since prototype launch, we’ve grown to $7.5M ARR (GMV run rate), and we are one of the top book sellers on social commerce platforms like TikTok Shop; we operate our own publishing imprints, and a creator/affiliate program of hundreds of active creators. Over the next quarter, we’re releasing our own titles (we publish at the speed of movements, not years), and within the next year, we’re opening up our platform so any author – regardless of station in life – can put their idea on paper and bring it to people who are eager to hear it.




The team is scrappy, ambitious, fast-moving, and highly entrepreneurial.




About the Role

We are hiring a Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead to own and scale one of the most important parts of Flowerburst’s growth engine: our TikTok Shop affiliate and VIP Special Ops creator program.




This is not ordinary affiliate management.




Flowerburst has access to a large catalog of top-selling books and uses performance data to identify products with viral TikTok Shop potential before the broader market fully catches on. When we find those products, we bring them to selected creators with a compelling offer: higher commissions, product insights, performance analysis, content hooks, sample support, GMV Max support, and a real partnership designed to help them grow their GMV.




The goal is to help creators win. When creators consistently post around the right products, the upside can be substantial for both the creator and Flowerburst.




You will manage relationships with top TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators, convert them into active VIP partners, and help them produce more videos that sell books. You will be responsible for turning creator interest into posting commitments, repeat content, GMV growth, and long-term creator partnerships.




This is a creator-facing growth role for someone who is organized, persuasive, commercially minded, and excited to help build a repeatable creator revenue engine.




What You’ll Do

You will manage Flowerburst’s VIP creator pipeline from outreach to activation.




This includes identifying promising creators, sending personalized outreach, following up, tracking next steps, coordinating samples, sharing product briefs, asking for posting commitments, monitoring creator activity, and reporting what is working.




You will help build creator launch pods around new book releases and high-potential VIP products. For each campaign, you will help match the right creators with the right products, share content angles, track sample delivery and first posts, and encourage creators to post multiple videos rather than just one.




You will build relationships with creators so they see Flowerburst as one of their best affiliate partners. You will give them useful product insights, help them understand why certain books may resonate with their audiences, and make them feel like part of an insider program.




You will also help build the operating system behind the program: clean tracking, weekly reporting, repeatable follow-up workflows, creator briefs, and simple SOPs.




Responsibilities
Manage a pipeline of TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators
Invite high-potential creators into Flowerburst’s VIP Special Ops Program
Send warm, persuasive, personalized outreach and follow-up messages
Clearly explain the creator opportunity and why selected products may help creators grow GMV
Track creator status, next steps, samples, posting commitments, and performance
Coordinate with internal operations on creator samples
Help creators understand which books to post and what angles may work
Build and manage creator launch pods for new book releases and VIP products
Ask creators for specific posting commitments
Track first post date, number of videos posted, repeat posting, and GMV
Re-engage creators who have sampled from Flowerburst in the past
Report weekly on creator pipeline, activity, and performance
Identify which creators, products, and content angles deserve more investment
Improve outreach, follow-up, campaign briefs, and creator management workflows




What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will learn Flowerburst’s products, creator program, and TikTok Shop affiliate workflow. You will understand the VIP Special Ops pitch deeply enough to explain it clearly to creators. You will clean up the creator tracker, follow up with warm creator leads, make sure every creator has a clear status and next action, help launch active creator pods, and establish weekly reporting.




You will also build a repeatable workflow for creator outreach, onboarding, follow-up, and campaign management. You will increase the number of VIP creators actively posting, track sample-to-post and post-to-GMV performance, help creators post multiple videos per campaign, own creator follow-up with minimal founder involvement, and create reusable creator briefs and campaign templates.




In your first 60 days, you will own the VIP creator program day-to-day, manage multiple creator launch pods, improve creator activation and repeat posting rates, and give leadership clear reporting on what is working.




In your first 90 days, you will help turn Flowerburst’s creator program into a predictable launch channel for new books and high-potential VIP products.




You Might Be a Fit If
You write excellent English
You communicate in a tone that is warm, casual, direct, and professional
You are highly organized and detail-oriented
You follow up consistently without needing reminders
You are comfortable managing many conversations at once
You have experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, account management, sales development, customer success, ecommerce, or partnerships
You are comfortable using spreadsheets, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, or similar tools
You can work independently and take ownership
You are comfortable asking people for commitments and following up when they do not deliver
You can understand performance data and translate it into simple, compelling creator-facing communication
You are interested in TikTok, creators, social commerce, books, media, or ecommerce




Bonus Points
Experience with TikTok Shop
Experience with influencer or affiliate programs
Experience working with U.S.-based creators
Experience in ecommerce or social commerce
Experience managing launch campaigns
Experience creating creator briefs or campaign briefs
Familiarity with BookTok, publishing, books, or media
Experience in a fast-moving startup environment
Experience with Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center, affiliate platforms, or creator CRM tools




Location and Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

We are equally interested in candidates based in South Africa, LATAM, and the Philippines.

You must be able to communicate with U.S.-based TikTok creators and affiliates during meaningful U.S. business-hour overlap, especially Eastern and Pacific afternoons.




Compensation

Expected base compensation:

$2,500–$3,500/month USD
Up to $4,000/month USD for an exceptional candidate




There is also significant performance bonus potential for measurable GMV growth.




This role has meaningful upside for the right person. If you help Flowerburst activate strong creators, increase repeat posting, and materially grow GMV from managed creator relationships, we want you to share in that success.




The bonus structure will be finalized after baseline performance and attribution are clear, but it will be tied to outcomes such as creator activation, videos posted, repeat posting, and incremental GMV from managed creators.




What We’re Looking For

We are not looking for a generic virtual assistant.




We are looking for someone who feels like a high-performing account manager, creator partnerships operator, or affiliate growth manager. You should be proactive, commercially minded, organized, and excellent in written communication.




The goal is not just to send messages. The goal is to turn creator relationships into videos, repeat posting, GMV, and long-term creator partnerships.




The right person should be excited about the opportunity Flowerburst can offer creators. We are bringing creators data-backed product opportunities, improved economics, performance support, and a real chance to grow their GMV.

description:
About the job

Hey, Dingus!




Yeah, you heard that right.




Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a Brand Operator to join our growing team! You’re probably thinking, “Wtf is a Brand Operator?” Keep reading. 👀




Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.




Purpose of the Role




The Brand Operator combines client relationship ownership with hands-on marketing production. You are the client’s main point of contact and one of the people actually making the work happen. This role exists because most agencies force clients to choose between “someone who understands your brand” and “someone who can execute.” We don’t think that tradeoff should exist, and neither will you.




About You




Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
Multifaceted, someone who steps up to the challenge
Proactive, always thinking about the needs of a client before they are
Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
Professional level of English (written and spoken)
Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful — you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
A background in marketing is essential
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better




The Skill Requirements




You need real, hands-on proficiency in at least 3–4 of the following:




Short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok, etc)
Social media strategy, content creation, and scheduling
Newsletter writing and editing
Brand strategy and positioning
Copywriting (web, ads, email, social)
Design fundamentals (Canva, Figma, or similar)
Basic analytics and reporting (knowing what a number means, not just where to find it)




Coordination skills alone will not meet the bar for this role. We already know you can manage a project. We need to know what you can build.




Main Objectives




1. Client Relationship Ownership

Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, understanding their goals well enough to make calls without needing a meeting first
Run regular check-ins, reviews, and strategy conversations that actually move the account forward, not just status updates
Translate client goals into a point of view, not just a task list




2. Hands-On Production

Personally execute against your core skills (video, social, newsletter, copy, brand, design, wherever you excel)
Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up ideation, drafting, and iteration. We want to see how you think with AI as a collaborator, not just how fast you can type a prompt
Maintain a quality bar on your own output before it goes to review, not after




3. Internal Collaboration

Work with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other Operators to fill gaps outside your core skills
Keep project tools (ClickUp and similar) current and accurate without needing to be chased
Give and receive direct feedback — we skip the sandwich method here




4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Help shape brand and marketing strategy for your accounts, not just execute against someone else’s plan
Continuously look for workflow improvements, especially ones involving AI, that let you do more without more hours
Manage multiple accounts without letting them quietly rot




Important Notes

Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional.




Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

We’re looking for an exceptional go-to-market and partnerships leader to own growth strategy and execution across Crunchyroll’s Latin America region.

As VP, Go-To-Market & Partnerships Marketing (LATAM), you'll lead the regional growth agenda across subscriber acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue. title: Analista de cartera y datos
description:
About the job

Analista de cartera y datos

100% remoto (México) · $22,000 a $25,000 MXN mensuales, por honorarios · Proyecto a 3 meses con revisión.




Somos una startup de cobranza para originadores de crédito en México. Lanzamos y operamos equipos de agentes de inteligencia artificial que negocian con deudores por mensajería y por teléfono. El cliente entrega su cartera y nosotros operamos la gestión completa: contacto, negociación, acuerdos y seguimiento.




Estamos firmando nuestros primeros clientes, serías de los primerxs en arrancar este proyecto con nosotros. Reportas directo a un cofundador, y los procesos de análisis que uses los primeros meses son los que va a heredar el equipo cuando crezca: los vas a escribir tú.




QUÉ VAS A HACER




Aproximadamente la mitad del tiempo es operación diaria: correr el reporte, perseguir datos que faltan, responderle al cliente. La otra mitad es análisis. Si la parte operativa no te interesa, este puesto no es para ti.




INDISPENSABLE




• SQL: joins, agregaciones, funciones de ventana.

• Python (pandas), de preferencia, o R.

• Excel al nivel de tablas dinámicas y búsquedas (XLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH), sin romper el archivo.

• Conceptos generales de crédito y cobranza: días de mora y buckets de atraso, saldo insoluto, quita o descuento, reestructura, tabla de amortización, castigo, promise taken/kept, roll rate.

• Datos reales y sucios. Sabes dejar rastro de qué le hiciste al dato y por qué.

• Presentar. Puedes tomar un análisis y convertirlo en cinco láminas que un director entienda sin que tú estés presente.




CONDICIONES




• 1 a 2 años de experiencia en cartera, riesgo, crédito o cobranza de un banco, SOFOM o despacho de cobranza; o en análisis de datos en general.

• Tres meses de proyecto, con revisión al cierre. Si funciona de los dos lados, pasa a posición permanente en nómina.

• Nos vemos en persona en Pachuca o CDMX de vez en cuando.

• Reportas al VP Comercial y de Operaciones, cofundador.




CÓMO APLICAR




Manda a hr2@nojucollect.ai (en asunto: nombre de la posición | tu nombre):




1. Tu CV.

2. Un ejemplo de análisis de datos que hayas hecho. Puede estar incompleto.

3. Dos o tres párrafos sobre algún proyecto que hiciste: (a) cuál era la pregunta que tenías que contestar; (b) qué encontraste mal en los datos y qué decidiste tirar o corregir y cómo lo hiciste; (c) qué te salió mal o qué harías distinto.

4. Tu disponibilidad de arranque.

Experience in delivering weekly and monthly business metrics and reporting
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
An ability to partner effectively with internal stakeholders
Background of identifying and remediating quality gaps in team performance
Passion for process improvement and innovation



Preferred Qualifications

Strong operational background including experience with new process launches and service delivery in a high growth technology company
Experience leading teams with multi-channel support

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

At TLNT, we believe that recruitment is more than just filling roles — it’s about connecting humans with humans. We’re a people-first organization partnering with top U.S. companies to help them grow by attracting exceptional talent, and we know that the right content can open the right doors.




You’ll join a verified membership organization for professional athletes — 2,500+ members across 60+ leagues. This is a closing role, and we’re not going to dress it up. You own new membership growth across both paid tiers, and you carry a number. Marketing drives awareness and inbound interest; you take it from there — moving quickly on athletes who raise their hand, and building your own outreach through referrals and relationships across the athlete and agent world. description:
About the job

About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to Fortune 500s - use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Come join our rapidly growing team in Guadalajara, and help us make global trade easy for everyone!

The Opportunity: 

Flexport's Global Operations team is the front line team responsible for successfully managing our Customer’s supply chains end to end. To achieve this the Global Operations Team is at the heart of delighting our customers, managing our partners and working closely with our technology partners to drive innovation through process automation. With our focus on developing a global network, our operational teams are strategically located across the world to manage and execute our services and products offered to our customers and partners. Flexport Global Operations raises the bar by using data to manage our customer’s supply chains and identifies opportunities to improve fidelity in planning, responsiveness and overall execution.

The Operations Associate is responsible for the ownership and execution of the end-to-end movement of global shipments within a regional network including Ocean less than and full container load (LCL and FCL), Ocean imports, Air imports and exports, and Cross-border trucking. This role will focus on driving a first in class customer experience by obsessing over quality and on time performance.

As a new team member in our Mexico Operations group, you'll begin by immersing yourself in our company culture and mastering world-class operations. As Flexport continues to grow, there could be opportunities for future Flexporters to become founding team members in new markets, relocate internationally, and help us expand our presence around the world. If you're interested in a fast-paced career with the potential for international experience, this opportunity could offer you unmatched growth and adventure.

You will: 


You will be the “front line” to ensure the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time and exceptions are handled appropriately. 
You will be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery. 
You will follow standard operating procedures (SOP) 
You will own the client experience; solving client issues quickly and ensuring smooth operations at origin and destination, escalating issues as needed. 
Your team will:
Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day logistics operations with internal and external partners such as steamship lines, air carriers, intermodal and drayage vendors, customs, trade lane management, warehousing, transloading, trucking, and the air operations team. 
Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements. 
You will assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy. 
You will quote and invoice client shipments with responsibility to their P&L
Participate in QBR and MBR presentation prep as well as hold client operational calls when deemed necessary


You should have:


2+ years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, ocean carrier operations, or consulting (ocean freight knowledge is a plus)
Bachelor’s Degree preferred
Able to adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast paced environment
Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks
Attention to detail
Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback
Effective communication both verbally and in writing in client facing interactions
Teamwork and relationship building
Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization
Problem-solving capabilities
Fluent in English and Spanish
A "compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Native mobile experience in Swift or Kotlin and an understanding of when dropping below the React Native layer is the right engineering decision.
Experience improving application performance, responsiveness and reliability across a range of mobile devices.
A background in taking loosely defined product problems and turning them into products or features with measurable client impact.

About the job

About the company




Arca.ph is a talent agency connecting skilled professionals with companies seeking exceptional remote talent. We’re recruiting a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer based in LATAM on behalf of a U.S. software company building cloud-based products and intelligent workflows for growing businesses.

In this role, you’ll work with the client’s product and engineering team, contributing across the full stack and owning work from discovery through production.




The opportunity




Our client is hiring a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer based in LATAM who can turn ambiguous product problems into scalable, maintainable software. You will work across modern web interfaces, APIs, backend services, data, and cloud infrastructure, with meaningful influence over architecture and engineering practice.




This role is a strong fit for an experienced product engineer who combines hands-on delivery with sound judgment: someone who can ship quickly, explain tradeoffs, improve systems over time, and help other engineers do their best work.




Core stack




TypeScript and JavaScript; React and Next.js; Node.js and Python; REST and GraphQL; PostgreSQL; AWS or GCP; Docker; CI/CD.




What you will own




• Design, build, test, release, and operate production features across the frontend, backend, data layer, and cloud environment.

• Create clear service boundaries, data models, APIs, and integration patterns that support growth without unnecessary complexity.

• Build accessible, responsive React and Next.js interfaces with strong performance, reusable components, and thoughtful product behavior.

• Develop reliable Node.js and Python services, REST or GraphQL APIs, background workflows, and third-party integrations.

• Help ship LLM-powered workflows and automation with appropriate evaluation, observability, human review, privacy controls, and failure handling.

• Improve automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, security, reliability, and application performance.

• Modernize legacy components pragmatically while protecting customer experience and delivery momentum.

• Lead technical discussions, review code and designs, document decisions, mentor engineers, and raise the bar for engineering quality.

• Partner with Product, Design, Data, and business stakeholders to define scope, surface risks, and deliver customer outcomes.

What senior means here




You own outcomes, not tickets. You clarify the problem, propose an approach, deliver it, and follow through in production. You balance speed and durability, strengthen the team through thoughtful design and mentorship, and communicate risks and tradeoffs early.




What success looks like




Within 30 days, you understand the product, customers, architecture, delivery process, and highest-leverage technical risks. Within 90 days, you have shipped a meaningful production feature and contributed to technical direction. Within 6–12 months, you own a major product or system area, have improved reliability or delivery velocity, and are actively shaping engineering standards.




Remote work expectations




This is a full-time remote role based in Colombia, working with a U.S.-based product team. You must maintain at least four working hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern or Central Time. The rest of the day may be flexible. Strong written communication, dependable follow-through, and comfort with asynchronous work are essential. Final employment or contractor structure depends on the hiring entity and candidate location.




Must-have requirements




• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production systems or major product features

• Strong TypeScript and JavaScript fundamentals with hands-on React experience; Next.js experience is highly relevant

• Strong backend engineering skills in Node.js and/or Python, including API design, asynchronous workflows, error handling, and service-level testing

• Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, query performance, migrations, and data integrity

• Experience designing and consuming REST APIs; GraphQL experience is valuable

• Production experience with AWS or GCP, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines

• Practical command of automated testing, code review, debugging, performance optimization, observability, and secure development

• Strong product judgment, written communication, and ability to work independently through ambiguity in a distributed team

• At least four working hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern or Central Time

Nice-to-have requirements




• Production experience with LLM-powered or AI-assisted features, including RAG, tool use, evaluation, and guardrails

• Java and Spring Boot or C# and .NET experience

• Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools

• Kubernetes, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka, or event-driven architectures

• B2B SaaS, workflow automation, multi-tenant systems, real-time applications, or regulated customer data

• Early-stage or fast-growing company experience

• A track record of mentorship, technical leadership, documentation, or architectural improvement

Job Description

 We are seeking an experienced SAP Global Trade Services (GTS) Consultant to provide Application Management Services (AMS) support for SAP S/4HANA and SAP GTS environments. The consultant will be responsible for supporting global trade compliance processes, customs management, export/import controls, sanctioned party screening, preference management, and integration between SAP GTS and SAP S/4HANA.

 Key Responsibilities

 AMS Support & Operations

 • Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP GTS processes and integrations.

 • Resolve incidents, service requests, and production issues within agreed SLAs.

 • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive solutions.

 • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end business-critical activities.




 SAP GTS Functional Support

 Support and maintain the following SAP GTS processes:







Compliance Management

 • Sanctioned Party List (SPL) Screening

 • Embargo Checks

 • Export Control Classification

 • License Determination and Management

 • Legal Control Processing




 Customs Management

 • Export Declaration Processing

 • Import Declaration Processing

 • Customs Duty Management

 • Bonded Warehouse Processes

 • Customs Communication Interfaces




 Integration & Technical Support

 • Support integration between SAP GTS and SAP S/4HANA/ECC.

 • Monitor IDOCs, RFCs, BAPIs, and middleware interfaces.

 • Coordinate with PI/PO, CPI, Basis, Security, and Functional teams for issue resolution.

 • Troubleshoot master data and transactional data replication issues.

 • Support interface testing and deployment activities

About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Graduate Partner Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Graduate Partner Marketing Manager, you aren’t just running campaigns; you are architecting the strategic relationships that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with the titans of tech:


Public cloud: AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle.
Silicon: NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD.
Global hardware: Dell, HP, Lenovo.



Early careers & growth

We are specifically looking for recent graduates who are serious about their success and ready to make a global impact. At Canonical, we prioritize talent and potential over years of experience; we will teach you the technical and commercial nuances of the open-source world through our structured career journey program. You will gain experience working with top tier talent and with multiple enterprise technologies. If you have the drive and a high standard for excellence, we provide the platform for you to become a world-class marketing leader.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region and will report to the Partner Marketing Team Manager.

Your impact


Architect joint success: Build high-velocity go-to-market plans with global partners, moving from initial messaging to full-scale pipeline generation.
Launch at scale: Lead integrated campaigns, industry announcements, and product launches that reach everyone from developers to C-suite decision-makers.
Creative packaging: Translate cutting-edge tech in the open-source world into educational and marketing content that resonates.
Ecosystem evolution: Shape and scale our partner programs to keep pace with an ever-expanding network of hardware vendors, software vendors, and channel resellers.



What We’re Looking For


The marketing basics: You understand how marketing works (especially within enterprises) and have familiarity with common marketing platforms, social media, and business technology.
The relationship builder: You can navigate complex and dynamic organizations and build lasting rapport.
The analytical thinker: You obsess over value and use data to decide which experiments to scale and which to iterate.
The self-starter: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment and aren't afraid to "roll up your sleeves" to get a project across the finish line.



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.


Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events



About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. description:
About the job

Job Description

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Change Orders

Perform initial review of incoming Change Requests to determine process flow and how to handle change.

Recognize the type of change entered and determine the level of action and how to proceed with items before sending them to the factory for processing.

Work with internal stakeholders to determine and quote the cost and lead-time impact of the requested changes.

Communicate with Emerson Impact Partners to resolve issues, notify them of the cost and lead-time impacts, and provide guidance on how to proceed with their change request including how the fees will be assessed.

Verify that the appropriate department has made the appropriate changes, and the updates have been documented in the FLEX portal, to assign the request to the next department to ensure the correct flow of the procedure.

Follow up the process and status of the change within each department involved in the process.

Ensure new line has been entered correctly by the Impact partner to proceed with the changes

Manages the ticker-orders dashboard to ensure correct process flow of change requests.

Pricing

Update pricing and commissions in Oracle and FF2 as needed.

Investigate and resolve pricing errors and disputes.

Ensure orders have been entered correctly per quotes provided.

Cancel orders that were entered with incorrect pricing and let the Entry User know they need to re-enter it correctly.

Have the authority to contact corrective billing to resolve pricing adjustments.

Order Entry

Enter and commit the orders that Impact Partners have transmitted in Rep Hold: fix unit and old price, tag, currency, deal and quantity errors, remove obsolete codes, enter no-charge orders, configure and set actuators and valves, change shipping information, entering change and expedites fees.

Override and source the items from the correct prime ship as needed.

Adjust and update the correct price on orders to match the quote already provided.

Route emergency and service orders

Error Correction

Ensure communication between the Impact Partner and the production support, error correction and DevOps teams so orders can be successfully transmitted from FF2 to Oracle.

Recognize the different errors and take action to correct and successfully transmit orders to the Oracle system, using tools and knowledge of FF2, XML files and Oracle.

Team Introduction:

The ideal candidate will help position CapCut as a leading AI creative tool in the LATAM market by increasing the scale, activity, and retention of high-quality AI creators, while driving industry influence and user mindshare through innovative AI content and events.

- Develop and execute a systematic marketing strategy for CapCut’s AI event ecosystem in LATAM, building CapCut’s own branded AI creative event IPs and campaigns.

- Collaborate with regional marketing and LATAM teams to cultivate relationships with leading brands, agencies, creator communities, and industry partners, and execute influential AIGC creative events.
- Identify, recruit, and manage high-potential AI creators across LATAM, designing long-term engagement and incentive programs to improve creator retention and showcase output.
- Plan and launch benchmark AI creator campaigns and case studies that amplify CapCut’s brand awareness, product influence, and AI market positioning.
- Monitor campaign and creator performance, analyze data and user feedback, and continuously optimize event operations and creator growth strategies.

- Bachelor’s degree or above, with 3+ years of experience in content marketing, event operations, creator/influencer operations, or related fields.
- Familiarity with AI image or video creation tools, and an existing network of AIGC creators/resources is mandatory.
- Strong understanding of the LATAM marketing landscape and major global social media platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X.
- Proven ability in campaign planning, creative event ideation, data analysis, and cross-functional project management.
- Fluent in English, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural, and cross-border team environment.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

About the job

Requisition ID: 72758

About Whirlpool Corporation

Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading home appliance company, in constant

pursuit of improving life at home. As the only major U.S.-based manufacturer of kitchen

and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving

needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid,

JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2025, the company reported

approximately $16 billion in annual net sales - close to 90% of which were in the Americas -

41,000 employees, and 35 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional

About

information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com.

The team you will be a part of

The Consumer Care team provides new and existing customers with the best possible service in relation to billing inquiries, service requests, suggestions and complaints. Resolves customer enquiries and complaints fairly and effectively. Provides product and service information to customers and identifies up selling opportunities to maintain and increase income streams from customer relationships.

This Role In Summary

The Senior Analyst for CX LAR Analytics serves as a critical link in the organization, responsible for connecting the dots between diverse streams of consumer feedback and strategic business intelligence to drive informed decision-making.

In this capacity, the position is required to conduct comprehensive deep dives into granular data collected from multiple consumer touchpoints—including structured surveys, call center interactions, and social media engagement. By synthesizing this information, the analyst identifies emerging market trends and pinpoints specific friction records within the consumer journey.

The ultimate objective of this role is to provide highly actionable insights and data-driven recommendations that empower cross-functional teams to resolve service gaps and consistently deliver a superior, seamless consumer experience across the LAR region.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Data Synthesis & Analysis: Extract and analyze data from the VoC ecosystem (NPS, CSAT, CES), providing a clear view of the consumer sentiment across different stages of the journey.

Multichannel Insight Generation: Process and interpret unstructured data from various sources, including speech-to-text transcripts, chat logs, and social media comments.

Root Cause Identification: Perform deep-dive analyses to correlate consumer pain points with operational data, helping to identify the "why" behind detraction.

Reporting & Dashboards: Develop and maintain high-quality dashboards (PowerBI/Tableau) and reports that communicate insights effectively to stakeholders and leadership.

Action Plan Support: Support cross-functional teams (Product, Logistics, Marketing) by providing the necessary data to build and track the success of improvement initiatives.

Closed-Loop Monitoring: Oversee the operational health of "close-the-loop" processes, ensuring that consumer feedback leads to internal learning and resolution..

Cross-Functional CX Project & Follow-up: Lead the end-to-end tracking and PMO execution of CX improvement projects across different operational departments, ensuring strict adherence to timelines, deliverables, and resolution metrics.

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.
